items.issue: The lede says «تراجعت أسعار النفط بأكثر من 3% في التعاملات المبكرة يوم الإثنين، بعدما عززت المحادثات بوساطة قطرية الآمال في اختراق دبلوماسي في الحرب على إيران.» (Oil prices fell by more than 3% (a percentage) in early Monday trading after Qatar-mediated talks raised hopes of a diplomatic breakthrough in the Iran war.). Source AGBI (Arabian Gulf Business Insight) says: "Oil prices fell in early Monday trading as talks mediated by Qatar raised hopes of a diplomatic breakthrough in the Iran war , despite fresh attacks on commercial shipping in the Gulf. Brent crude dropped more than $3 a barrel as Iranian officials continued discussions over a proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.". The source says Brent dropped more than $3 a barrel in early Monday trading, not more than 3%.
items.reason: The lede's «أكثر من 3%» is accurate: the story's own figures give Brent down 3.91% to 109.00 dollars and WTI down 4.1% in early Monday trading, and Brent falling more than 3 dollars a barrel, as AGBI reports, is the same move in dollars, so the two are consistent.
